title: U.S. House, District 20
what_it_does: Represents Florida's 20th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives; votes on federal laws and spending.
verified_ballot_note: Regular (full-term) election for the newly drawn CD 20. Roster from CBS Miami, WSVN and WLRN: Debbie Wasserman Schultz (D) faces Republican nominee Brent Andersen and NPA candidate Kedner Maxime; Kevin McClellan filed as a write-in (CBS Miami; a Ballotpedia snippet lists him as NPA, so his ballot status should be checked against the county sample ballot). Special election: the seat has been vacant since Rep. Sheila Cherfilus-McCormick resigned Apr. 21, 2026. CBS Miami reported Gov. DeSantis scheduled a special primary for Aug. 18, 2026 with the winner advancing to the Nov. 3 general election, under the pre-2026 district lines; the special-election nominees were not identified in this research, so voters in the old CD 20 may see two CD 20 contests on Nov. 3. Sources: https://www.cbsnews.com/miami/news/2026-florida-primary-district-20-republican-brent-andersen/ ; https://wsvn.com/news/politics/wasserman-schultz-gop-brent-andersen-win-primary-in-redrawn-district-20/ ; https://www.cbsnews.com/miami/news/florida-district-20-sheila-cherfilus-mccormick-resignation-special-election-candidates/ ; https://cbs12.com/news/cbs12-news-i-team/florida-congressional-district-20-cherfilus-mccormick-resignation-redistricting-special-election-map-questions-future-cost-limbo-representation-contest ; https://ballotpedia.org/Florida's_20th_Congressional_District_election,_2026 . The new district covers central and western Broward County (portions of Fort Lauderdale, Lauderhill, Lauderdale Lakes, Tamarac, North Lauderdale, Plantation, Sunrise and Pompano Beach), per CBS Miami. Florida adopted a new congressional map (passed Apr 29, 2026, signed May 4, 2026) that reworked 21 of 28 districts.

candidates.name: Debbie Wasserman Schultz
candidates.photo_source: congress.gov member portrait (bioguide ID from memory, unverified)
candidates.background: Debbie Wasserman Schultz has served in the U.S. House since 2005 and currently represents Florida's 25th District; after the 2026 map moved her home out of that district she ran in the new 20th. She won the Aug. 18, 2026 Democratic primary with about 45% (more than 30,000 votes), defeating former Broward Mayor Dale Holness (about 23%), former Rep. Sheila Cherfilus-McCormick, teacher Elijah Manley and Luther Campbell. Note: she is a sitting member of Congress but not the incumbent for the CD 20 seat, which is vacant.
candidates.primary_result: Won Aug 18, 2026 Democratic primary with ~45% over Holness (~23%), Cherfilus-McCormick, Manley and Campbell (CBS Miami; WLRN)

candidates.occupation: Founder and president, Pilgrim Bay Insurance Agency
candidates.background: Brent Andersen is the founder and president of Pilgrim Bay Insurance Agency, which focuses on construction, commercial real estate and high-net-worth clients. He won the Aug. 18, 2026 Republican primary for the redrawn 20th District over Army veteran Rod Joseph, Navy veteran Carla Spalding and Lateresa 'LA' Jones, and has campaigned on public safety, education and lowering insurance costs.
